mission: Minimal MalCare-safe reachability test of the production crawler API path (api-date-since-watermark via WC Store API + WP REST core). NOT a full walk.
productionUserAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36 (deterministic md5('dlaskarms.com')[0]%4 = idx 0; userAgentOverride is null)

reachabilityVerdict.markerScan: Every response body scanned for /malcare/i, 'Blocked because of Malicious', /mod_security/i, 'not acceptable'. ZERO markers across all 9 requests.
reachabilityVerdict.gapVsBudget: Held DB baseBudget=1800/hr implies a ~2s minimum inter-request gap (not 4s as the R2 brief assumed). Probe ran at 3s gaps and stayed clean across both API and HTML. The production crawler uses the API path; the DB-documented IP-ban trigger was a ~20-request burst, far above the 1800/hr steady-state rate.

corrections.evidence: 9 production-UA requests across Store API products (p1/p2/count), WP REST core /wp/v2/product, and rifles category HTML — all HTTP 200, no MalCare/406 markers. Real JSON payloads (95-98KB per page). The production maintain path (store-api verify on /wp-json/wc/store/v1/products) and watermark discovery path (/wp-json/wp/v2/product modified_after) are both live and clean at >=3s pace.
corrections.proposedValue: Enable (isEnabled=true) with conservative pacing; keep baseBudget=1800 (>=2s gap). API path is the crawler's path and it is reachable.

corrections.evidence: Live X-WP-Total=235 from BOTH /wp-json/wp/v2/product?per_page=1 and /wp-json/wc/store/v1/products?per_page=1 on 2026-06-02. DB siteProfile holds stale 241 (lastVerified 2026-04-11). R1 also observed 235.

MalCare IS present per 2026-04-11 DB ground truth (403 body marker + 406 bot-UA, IP-ban after ~20-request burst). It did NOT fire on any of the 9 slow-paced production-UA requests in this probe. The 2026-05-11 calibration heavy-8-batch also saw all-200/no-marker. MalCare blocks BURSTS, not the steady API path. Keep hasWaf:true defensively but it does not block the crawl path at sane pace.
corrections.proposedValue: Keep hasWaf:true, wafType:malcare. NOT a hard blocker for the API path at >=2s gap.

corrections.evidence: DB template is 'page/{N}/' with NO leading slash (R1 ledger theme-B: buildPaginatedUrl mangles this). This is a latent runtime defect, not a reachability issue, but flagged for Round 4 fix. Note: production crawler uses the API path (api-date-since-watermark), so HTML pagination is the fallback only.

notes: VERDICT: SAFE-TO-ENABLE. The production crawler's API path (WC Store API /wp-json/wc/store/v1/products for maintain verify + WP REST core /wp-json/wp/v2/product for watermark discovery) is fully reachable under the production UA at >=3s pace with zero MalCare/406 signals.

MalCare's documented ban trigger (DB 2026-04-11) is a ~20-request BURST that 403s for 10+ minutes. The held baseBudget=1800/hr equals a ~2s steady gap, well below burst territory. This probe deliberately used only ~9 requests at 3s gaps to avoid re-triggering the ban; it did not test the ban threshold (intentional — inconclusive-on-threshold beats risking a ban).
Bot-UA caveat: the DB notes Googlebot UA -> 406. The production UA is the real Chrome/120 string (verified above), NOT a bot UA, so 406 is not a risk on the production path.

Did NOT do a full catalog walk (out of scope + ban-avoidance). Coverage proof (catalogUrls vs 235 dedup) remains a later task; the 2026-05-11 calibration used /shop/ as a single 100%-coverage aggregator URL while R1 used the 20-cat parent:0 spine — that spine-vs-aggregator choice is unresolved but does NOT affect reachability.

Enable recommendation is conditional on keeping pacing conservative: the crawler must NOT burst. At baseBudget=1800/hr (~2s gap) and API-only path, the documented ~20-req burst threshold is not approached during normal tier crawling. If any future crawl logs a 403/406 from dlaskarms, treat as MalCare re-block and back off (cooldown), do not retry-storm.
Stale DB field also noted: siteProfile.crawlPhase says 'maintain' but the DB column crawlPhase='bootstrap' (R1 ledger B-column mismatch). Round 4 transition concern, not reachability.
